title: Exclude hidden rendered layers from copied quotes
outcome: Blockquote copy uses innerText, which can include both KaTeX's visually hidden MathML and visible HTML representations, producing duplicated clipboard content. Derive text from visible content only, account for other hidden renderer layers, and add a quote-with-math regression test.
